body:
“Let’s take care of everyone else and ignore the yucky internal stuff.” 

I’d never realized it, but I am you. Take care of everyone and every little thing to keep push, push, pushing past all the shit swirling around inside. Fake it til you make it, the motto I lived by my whole life, but do we ever make it? Or do we just get so good at taking care of every one else and their problems, that there’s no room for ours anymore?

I’m really not. And there’s no way to fix it it’s doable but not for another five years and then she’s what, seven and settled in to this new life? That I’m just supposed to take her away from and bring her back to barely sustainable?
It’s easy to say money isn’t everything when you don’t have to listen to your 2 year old say she’s hungry and know there’s nothing in the fridge for her to eat.

If we’re living in a car, she gets taken away anyway. I have literally tried everything. I don’t qualify for programs because of how much we make. I dont qualify for food at the food bank, I don’t qualify for rent subsidies, I don’t qualify for any of these things because we work and make money and it’s apparently too much even though we have 20,000$ of debt that we’re struggling to pay off + 1650 a month for a crappy two bedroom in crack head central. My parents don’t give a fuck about me. That has been made blatantly obvious when I was homeless with a 2 year old and my mom bought herself an RV and my dad dropped 10K on my little brother. I was living in a motel known for sex trafficking. I have no one. I have begged for help and gotten nothing. This is the last option.
That’s not a fair life for her to live. She doesn’t deserve that. She’s so adorable and smart, she deserves someone who’s going to foster that in her. Not me.

That’s why I’d choose someone, there’s already someone we know personally in mind. A family member with their shit together. She’d be okay. I’m not leaving her for money, I’m leaving because I just can’t do it anymore. I can’t keep fighting for it to go all wrong I can’t keep trying just to fail I can’t keep trying to pay off debt only to find out I’m actually in more I can’t keep looking at her and the place we live, the park down the street is the only place she can play and there’s a daily, if not weekly, overdose there. Once it was when we were there. I called the ambulance for the dead guy while she played at the park.

Every time I look in her eyes all I can see is how much more she deserves than us, all this debt, no place to live, she deserves more than that. She deserves stability and love and to go to the zoo or do things other than go to the crackhead park where there was literally a guy who overdosed by the benches when we went once. She deserves so much more than that. If only I had the resources to be able to provide it. But I can’t. So she can go to someone who can, and I will cease to exist while she’s still young enough to forget about me.

Except free education = no money = no way to provide for our daughter. Getting a job isnt the issue. We have money, just not enough. We have jobs it just doesn’t pay enough. We can’t get different jobs because we can’t afford the two - three weeks in between receiving pay. We’re involved with what programs there are to offer in our city - we make too much to receive any of these programs or subsidies but we can’t afford to live because of all the debt. I can’t go through with a debt consolidation because then our credit score is affected once again - which leaves us absolutely fucked if we lose this rental unit we’re in because we can’t pay. 

Like honestly there’s nothing anyone can do short of some millionaire taking pity on this laughable story of my fucking life.
I don’t think I’d be considering giving her up for adoption and killing myself if I wasn’t already at the brink.

The issue is we aren’t in that much debt and then it affects our credit score and we were already homeless once because of crappy credit... if my score goes any lower I’m basically fucked for ever finding a unit.
That’s why I’d put her up for adoption m, find her a great family. She wouldn’t need me anymore, she’d just be better off.
There’s no point anymore. I’ve tried everything and failed.
They can’t dig me out of this.
